title: Keto Bhuna Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful keto stir fry cooked in the bhuna style, perfect for a low-carb dinner.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add beef strips and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove beef from the skillet and set aside.
Add sliced onion to the skillet and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add stir-fry mix and cook until vegetables are tender-crisp, about 4-5 minutes.
Return beef to the skillet and stir in bhuna sauce.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until sauce is bubbly and slightly thickened.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped cilantro, if desired.
